gemini.prompt_template:
Today is {today}. I already have these world news stories: {covered_summary}

Search for major world news today NOT already covered. Focus on:
- conflict: wars armed conflict military operations geopolitics today
- economy: global economy trade tariffs inflation central bank decisions today
- climate: climate change extreme weather environmental news today
- health: global health pandemic disease outbreak WHO news today

DO NOT include URLs. Return JSON with 4 keys, each 2-3 story objects (title, summary 2 sentences, source, date):
{"conflict":[],"economy":[],"climate":[],"health":[]}
Return ONLY valid JSON.
